Trains operating between the mine area to the railroad trunk line near Hysham constitute another sound source. Sound level recordings were made during train passbys approximately 130 feet from the train at Location 4. Two sets of data were obtained, one of an empty train entering the mine area and another of a loaded train leaving the mine area. Peak sound levels for empty and loaded conditions were approximately 85 dB.
Vegetation
Southeastern Montana is located within the prairies and plains, or grassland province (Gleason and Gronquist, 1964). The vegetation of Tracts II and III and the surrounding area is typical of a large portion of southeastern Montana. Table II-15 shows relative coverage of the major vegetation types within the Tracts; the distribution of the various types is shown in Map II-3.
Vegetation types are described in detail in Westmoreland Resources
Environmental Baseline Studies (Westmoreland Resources, 1975 o). A list
of plant species indentified in the lease area is presented in Appendix
E. Following are brief discussions of the various types abstracted from
the report.
Ponderosa Pine (Pinus ponderosa) - grassland type - This vegetation type is the most predominant on the Project Area. Typically, the Ponderosa Pine - grassland type occurs on upper slopes and ridges with shallow well-drained soil derived f im scoria or sandstone and extends into lower elevations along drainage bottoms. Stand density and size of trees is extremely variable, ranging from savannah type stands to extremely dense "doghair" thickets.
